heading: INSTAGRAM PUTS NEW LIMITS ON UNDISCLOSED AI PROFILES (2 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Instagram is renaming its “AI creator” label to “AI-generated profile” to make it clearer when an account features a fully AI-generated person. It will also limit recommendations for unlabeled AI profiles, while creators who proactively disclose their AI identity won't see a reach penalty. The change targets transparency around AI personas, not creators who use AI tools in their content workflow.

heading: META IS PUTTING HARD LIMITS ON FACEBOOK AND INSTAGRAM AFTER $17 BILLION SETTLEMENT (3 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Instagram and Facebook will default minors to 2 hours of daily use, with overnight access blocked and school-hour notifications muted.
